title: Converging Measures and an Emergent Model: A Meta-Analysis of Human-Automation Trust Questionnaires
findings: The paper presents an emergent, validated model of human-automation trust. One of the antecedents in this model is 'Faith in Technology,' a dispositional factor that influences trust formation, especially in initial interactions. However, this concept is entirely secular and distinct from religious faith. The paper makes no findings related to religion.

measurement_description: This paper does not benchmark or measure religious faith. It conducts a meta-analysis of human-automation trust questionnaires. The term 'faith' is used in a secular context, specifically as 'Faith in Technology,' which is defined as a dispositional trust or belief in technology's capabilities that is not necessarily based on direct evidence or experience.
